basicDetails.schemeName: Aawasiy Suvidha 1 – Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing)

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme “Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing)” is implemented by the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority under the Housing Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration process and lottery-based allotment.
schemeContent.benefits_md: Under this scheme, residential facilities are provided to homeless families.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration process and lottery-based allotment.

children.text: The scheme “Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing)” is implemented by the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority under the Housing Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration process and lottery-based allotment.
Under this scheme, residential facilities are provided to homeless families.
The Authority selects residential units through registration and allotment is done through lottery draw.

applicationProcess.process_md: The Authority selects residential units through registration and allotment is done through lottery draw.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

children.text: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
The required documents must be submitted as per the guidelines of the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority.

en.documentsRequired_md: The required documents must be submitted as per the guidelines of the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the scheme?

children.text: All homeless families who are residents of Uttarakhand are eligible to apply.

faqs.answer_md: All homeless families who are residents of Uttarakhand are eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What is the aim of the scheme?

children.text: The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration and lottery-based allotment process.

faqs.answer_md: The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration and lottery-based allotment process.

faqs.question: How are residential units allocated?

children.text: Residential units are allocated through a lottery draw after completing the registration process.

faqs.answer_md: Residential units are allocated through a lottery draw after completing the registration process.

faqs.question: Can non-residents of Uttarakhand apply for the scheme?
How can eligible families register for the scheme?

children.text: Eligible families can register through the official registration process conducted by the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority.

faqs.answer_md: Eligible families can register through the official registration process conducted by the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority.

faqs.question: How are the beneficiaries selected?

children.text: Beneficiaries are selected through a transparent lottery draw conducted by the Authority.

faqs.answer_md: Beneficiaries are selected through a transparent lottery draw conducted by the Authority.
